usageNotes: Use this to update the DNS resolver configuration on a specific Proxmox node, including the search domain and up to three nameserver IPs. The `search` field is required; omitting any `dns` field leaves that slot cleared in `/etc/resolv.conf`. The caller must hold `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}`, and the node must be online — there is no async task; the change takes effect immediately.

examples.summary: Set search domain and two nameservers on node pve01

tips: Omitting dns1/dns2/dns3 clears those slots — always pass all resolvers you want to keep, not just the one you're changing.
This writes directly to the node's /etc/resolv.conf; in a clustered setup each node must be updated independently.
Returns null on success — a 2xx with empty body is the expected response, not an error.
